knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The change is recorded against the intake record from the same position, with its date and position. The cause is not assumed.
People are photographed only with their consent.
The lesson says to record the condition of each room and fixed item with dated, referenced photographs taken from the same positions each time.

practicalCriteria: Given intake and handover photographs of a simulated room, the worker identifies one change and records it with date and position.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Comparison record for the simulated room
stopWorkCriteria: Photographs would show personal items or people without consent
